§1THE PLANT SHOWS ITS WORKING§r
At the foot of the GUI - and of both control blocks, and the scanner - sits a group called §9MATH§r: §8how that EU/t is derived§r. It walks your CURRENT output in four numbered steps, every factor carrying the value it has right now:

 §9 1§r 201 pillars x9 fuel x16,384 = 29,638,656 L/t
 §9 2§r x1.55 spine speed x1.00 efficiency = 46,028,832 L/t
 §9 3§r x RPM 12,000/500 x rotors = 1,104,691,968 EU/t demand
 §9 4§r under ceiling 1,610,645,504 -> 1,104,691,968 EU/t out
§8The panel rounds each factor to two places: the spine speed in line 2 is 1.553.§r

Burn a MIXED silo and step 1 says so instead of flattering you:§8 45 pillars avg x6.69 fuel (32x9 + 13x1) x16,384§r. With §9no rotor turning§r - no gallery at all, or a gallery of empty housings - the whole group re-titles itself §8how that steam figure is derived§r and step 3 becomes the export line. The title turns on ROTORS SEATED, not on housings placed, so it can never invent a generator you have not finished.

Then a fifth line, §1Weakest term§r, ranks pillars filled, fuel grade, throttle, spine, and - only where a generator exists - RPM, rotor condition and the output clamp, names the one costing you the most, and tells you the fix.

§8The RPM entry is not one answer but five: no Spiral chamber, no injectors fitted, §cinjectors dry§r, §cchamber cannot be cooled§r, or simply cycle faster. It follows the interlock's own order of refusal, so this line and the §9HOLD:§r line above it can never name two different faults for the same tick. The other entries are just as literal - an EMPTY silo is told to stack Reactor Fuel Pillar Frames rather than to keep a bus stocked, and a duct with no housings in it is told it is EMPTY rather than told to wrench four housings that are not there.§r

§5§lDO §lTHIS§r
Read the Weakest term line. Fix that one thing. Read it again. Repeat until it says §2Every term is at its ceiling§r. This quest asks for one Thorium-Bonded rod because "fuel grade" is almost always the first answer it gives you.

§5§lAND §lIN §lNEI§r
Look the Nuclear Plant Foundation up in NEI. It is the catalyst for three tables - §9fuel rods§r, §9propellant§r and §9coolant§r - carrying every multiplier, every ladder rung and the arithmetic behind them, plus which socket each one enters by. §8Display pages: nothing on them is craftable, and nothing there is consumed.§r

§2§lDONE §lWHEN§r
A Thorium-Bonded Fuel Rod is in your inventory - one rung up the ladder, off the back of that line. §8Claim it, then feed it to the bus. The two fluid ladders opened back at step 7 because step 8 needed them; Break the Clamp, Spin Doctrine and Written in Fire open here, and all of it is optional depth.§r

§1AND THAT IS THE BUILD FINISHED - NOT THE CAMPAIGN§r
The ten steps were CONSTRUCTION. What the plant does from here is EARN: four milestone lines climb just by running, seven tiers each, paying multipliers into the very derivation you have just learned to read and then unlocking maxima this plant has never had - control rods past 24/24, a redline above 12,000, cheaper water, faster modules. They also pay the points that buy a twenty-five node upgrade tree.
Every counter starts at zero, and the first tier arrives within the hour. §1Open THE CAMPAIGN BEGINS on the campaign row, under the blueprints.§r
